essence: The practitioner should utter the all-speech-form and remember it with phaṭ for the weapon.
The all-speech-form is defined by its power to remove obstacles and sins.
The all-speech-form permanently grants all desires and universal sovereignty.
Only a generous, noble-born person devoted to pure conduct is a fit recipient.
After performing the rite thus, one should reveal it to the practitioner.
